title: 7 Segment Display
body:
"Allows you to display numbers. Bottom middle input allows you to provide a number input to display. Bottom left input allows you to provide a color. Top middle output is a passthrough for the number input. Optionally, you can individually activate every segment."

The 7 Segment Display is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It accepts logic signals to light up sections of its display.

Functionality

The 7 Segment Display has seven inputs on the back which can be activated individually to light up the corresponding segment, with a brightness ranging from a signal of 0 (unlit) to 15 (maximum brightness). There are also two extra inputs on the bottom which accept larger signals. The input in the middle controls the displayed number: this accepts signals from 0 to 10, where 0 turns off the display, 1-9 are mapped to their respective numbers, and 10 displays 0. This input will light up parts of the matrix with a brightness equivalent to receiving a signal of 10. The input to the side bottom changes the color of the display.

Top middle output is 10 when number is displayed and 0 when nothing is displayed.

7 Segment Display scheme
Colors:

  • 0 - white
  • 1 - red
  • 2 - orange
  • 3 - yellow
  • 4 - green
  • 5 - blue
  • 6 - cyan
  • 7 - pink
  • 8 - purple
  • 9 - bright white
  • 10 - black
  • All others - white

Trivia

  • Description says about top middle input while it's an output.
